body: Person requested paired work and better communication. FrozenNativeProof owns one complete verification batch/report on immutable eecb23d9; FrozenNativeReview independently checks native safety/coverage read-only in parallel. Both received the same up-front c1/c2 ledger, exact source, existing21/lint/all-three-types matrix and current role policy. Findings go to partner and Main early; decisions stay Main. No late edits or filtered-suite substitute. Later implementation tickets will use the same early review/freeze/check handoff rather than defer safety review until the deadline. Parent retains acceptance authority and actual host metering.
